faq.floristBody: Tell us who it's for and what she loves. A florist in {city} replies in English or Italian and can build something just for her.

pay.q: Can I pay from outside Italy?
pay.a: Yes — prices are in euro and your bank converts. Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal work from any country.

exact.a: In {city} our own riders arrive within 15 minutes either side of the time you book. If we're late, the time fee is refunded automatically.

notHome.a: You choose at checkout: leave it with a neighbour or the portiere, call her, or bring it back later. We always message you with what happened.

look.q: Will it look like the photo?
look.a: Flowers vary slightly by season; we always match style, colours and value — and you see the real bouquet in your photo before delivery.

cutoff.a: Order before the same-day cut-off shown at checkout for the recipient's area; later orders go out next day.

rome.title: Flower delivery in {city}
rome.intro: Order from anywhere in the world and we hand-deliver in {city} the same day — in 15-minute slots from 07:00 to 23:45, with a photo of the real bouquet before it leaves. All-in prices, delivery included.

city.intro: Send flowers to {city} with next-day courier delivery across Italy. Boxed to arrive fresh, with all-in prices and delivery included.

national.title: Send flowers to Italy, from anywhere
national.intro: Same-day in Rome by our own riders, next-day everywhere else in Italy by courier. All-in prices, and a photo of the real bouquet before delivery.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.lead: All-in prices, delivery included. We send a photo of the real bouquet before it leaves — so you know exactly what arrives.
delivery.romeBody: Our own riders deliver across {city} the same day, in exact 15-minute slots from 07:00 to 23:45. Choose Standard (any time that day), a 2-hour window, or an exact time — the window and exact-time fees are shown for your area at checkout.
delivery.nationalBody: Everywhere else in Italy, bouquets are boxed to arrive fresh and delivered the next day by courier. You pick the delivery date.
delivery.cutoffBody: Order before the daily cut-off for {city} to get same-day delivery. The exact cut-off and any time fees for the recipient’s area are confirmed at checkout.
delivery.photoBody: Before every delivery we send a photo of the finished bouquet to the sender by WhatsApp and email.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Everything about ordering, delivery times and the photo-before-delivery promise.

about.title: Our workshop
about.lead: Roma Fiorita helps people abroad send flowers to loved ones in Italy — with the trust that the right bouquet arrives, on time.
about.body1: We work with florists in Rome, deliver same-day with our own riders, and send a photo of the real bouquet before it leaves. Prices are all-in, with delivery included.
about.body2: Outside Rome we deliver next-day across Italy by courier, boxed to arrive fresh.
about.trust1: A photo of the real bouquet before delivery.
about.trust2: All-in prices — delivery included, no surprises.
about.trust3: On-time delivery, down to an exact 15-minute slot in Rome.

legal.perishableBody: Because flowers are perishable goods made to order, the statutory 14-day right of withdrawal does not apply once an order is confirmed, in line with EU consumer law.
